headline: Hackers Divert €100 Million From French Bank in Cyber Fraud Incident
summary: Hackers diverted €100 million from a French bank in an attack involving fraudulent transactions with other financial institutions, though customer funds remain safe.
why: Cybersecurity breaches targeting financial institutions highlight operational risks and compliance costs for the banking sector.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Cyber attacks on financial institutions expose operational vulnerabilities and potential financial losses.
